speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your breast mass, can you tell me how long you've noticed this lump and if it has changed in size recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Have you noticed any changes in your skin, nipple discharge, or the presence of lymph node swelling in your armpit? Also, have you experienced any systemic symptoms like fever or unexplained weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No family history of breast cancer. Social history: Non-smoker, moderate alcohol use. Elementary school teacher.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, night sweats, or changes in appetite. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
I understand your concern, but we must first review the results of the Mammography and Ultrasound I ordered to ensure accuracy before giving a final answer. Are you willing to wait for these images and reports, or would you prefer I make a guess based solely on your description?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Invasive Ductal Carcinoma (pending imaging confirmation).
